title: fxv workspace optimize failure detail
description: What failed in an `fxv workspace optimize`. Only ever a detail payload, riding in an error envelope's `error_data` with `kind` of `workspace-optimize-failed`. A repository the optimize was asked for that it doesn't list was optimized, or needed nothing. When only some namespaces of a repository failed, each of its namespaces that isn't listed was optimized or needed nothing. A failure of a whole repository says nothing of its namespaces: some can have been merged before it failed.

failures.description: Each failure, of a namespace or of a whole repository.

repository.description: The repository that failed: this workspace's draft repository, or the published repository.

namespace.description: The namespace that failed, such as 'content', or null for a failure of the whole repository, such as another process holding its optimize lock.
